question.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14224606/assets/175d15b140a660148d8890cf32f4c4b79a43ff86d82c7e4461174326dfa9eeca.png)

Find the volume of the rectangular prism shown above.
question.worked_solution:
We can find the volume $V$ of the rectangular prism using the formula

$$
V=lwh,
$$

where $l$ is the length, $w$ is the width, and $h$ is the height of the solid.

Substituting 

$$
l=7\,\text{in},\,w=2\,\text{in},\,h=3\,\text{in}
$$

into the formula, we obtain

$$
V=7\cdot 2\cdot 3=42\,{\text{in}}^{3}.
$$
